cases.case_label: Full-length L1 (Ta1d) in APC intron 7 creating pseudo-exon (FAP)
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous full-length sense-oriented L1 (Ta1d, 3' transduction traced to a chr17 source) in APC intron 7 provides a splice acceptor in the TSD and a donor in the L1 5' promoter region, creating a 103-bp pseudo-exon between exons 7 and 8 with a premature stop; transcripts undergo NMD (allelic imbalance, cycloheximide rescue) with near-complete loss of the allele. Segregates in three affected relatives.
cases.quote: Targeted PCRs on blood-derived cDNA revealed a splice acceptor gain in the target-site duplication and a splice donor gain in the LINE-1 element, leading to a 103 bp pseudo-exon between exons 7 and 8 of APC (Fig.
